arguments.Title: Inspect reconnected road scene
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine;using UnityEditor;using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;using System.Linq;internal class CommandScript:IRunCommand {public void Execute(ExecutionResult result){result.Log("PROJECT "+Application.dataPath);foreach(var i in Enumerable.Range(0,SceneManager.sceneCount)){var s=SceneManager.GetSceneAt(i);result.Log("SCENE "+s.path+" dirty="+s.isDirty);}result.Log("repair class available; active bindings="+Object.FindObjectsByType<CampusSim.CampusTerrainBinding>(FindObjectsSortMode.None).Length);}}
